purpose: external acceptance instrument for the ProgressDesk core delivery
criteria: every adapter translates its harness's native shape into the same closed vocabulary of conditions, and the framework decides on the contract alone
a condition that is unknown is recorded with its evidence, surfaced to the owner, and handed to the observer
the taxonomy version travels with every classification, so a later reader can tell which rules were in force
word matching can only narrow an unknown into a known condition; it never changes a known condition and never decides an action
capacity is never nudged, a provider fault is nudged, and a configuration fault is not
an adapter that cannot report whether the model answered is refused rather than routed
